# Drizzle migrations (M1-owned). Generated by `bunx drizzle-kit generate` (config: repo-root
# `drizzle.config.ts`). The journal (`meta/_journal.json`) is authoritative — custom SQL
# migrations are added via `drizzle-kit generate --custom` so they register in order.
#
# M1-T04 (Foundation initial migration, spec §3.11–3.12):
#   0000_foundation_initial                  — enums + all 16 table DDL (Drizzle-generated)
#   0001_foundation_rls_roles_partitioning   — DB roles, append-only GRANT model,
#                                               audit_event RANGE partitioning + rotation,
#                                               RLS policies keyed on app.org_id
#   0002_feature_flag_global_read            — isolated org-NULL global-flag READ policy
#   0003_organization_settings_and_outbox_catalog — settings collision trigger + registry indexes
#   0004_foundation_audit_triggers           — baseline write-audit triggers (M4 supersedes
#                                               with the full generator + denylist scrubbing)
#
# M2-T02 (Identity & Org schema, spec §3.3–3.9):
#   0005_identity_m2_tables                  — two_factor, passkey, organization_invitation,
#                                               tenant_step_up_policy_override (+ enums)
#                                               (Drizzle-generated)
#   0006_identity_m2_rls_audit_triggers      — app.org_id RLS on the two org-scoped tables,
#                                               append-only GRANT model, write-audit triggers;
#                                               two_factor/passkey follow the M1 user-owned,
#                                               cross-org pattern (un-RLS'd, app-layer scoped)
#   0007_session_class_step_up_fields        — session class + step-up columns (M2 follow-up)
#
# M3-T04 (Authorization RLS + migration, spec §3.6–3.7):
#   0008_authorization_m3_tables             — permission, role, role_permission,
#                                               membership_role, break_glass_event,
#                                               auditor_engagement (+ enums) (Drizzle-generated)
#   0009_authorization_m3_rls_audit_triggers — app.org_id RLS + GRANT model + baseline
#                                               write-audit triggers on the five org-scoped
#                                               M3 tables; permission is SELECT-only reference.
#                                               M4-T10 normalizes the triggers to the canonical
#                                               generator (denylist scrubbing).
#   0010_authorization_role_template_read    — isolated org-NULL READ policy for the platform
#                                               role templates (role / role_permission), the
